Streaming chat completion that produces content across multiple SSE chunks

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to 3\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true}") |> Enum.to_list()
IO.inspect(result)
```
